assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: premium photoreal decorative wristband hero for Proximeet mobile intent selection.
Create ONE extraordinary coral woven wristband, isolated on genuinely transparent alpha. A broad, continuous 22 mm textile band curves into a generous open oval, like an exquisite reusable event wristband rather than a watch. View from slightly above and straight in front: rear half of the oval arches upward, front half rests lower; inner negative space remains clearly visible. Width-to-height of the object about 1.8:1. Its front-center has a small precise low-profile brushed stainless steel clasp bridging the woven strap, with a thin graphite gasket, realistic seam, restrained chamfer and a completely BLANK flat front face. Closed clasp, no loose dangling end. The clasp should feel small and expertly made, not a giant plate. No watch face, no screen, no sensor, no jewelry stones. Slight natural textile tension and gentle curvature, outstanding fine fiber detail.
Color and textile: warm human coral fabric, richly saturated yet sophisticated, with an elegant tight basket-weave and subtly lighter edge stitching. Tiny balanced graphite hardware accents. Light ivory stitch line only at outer edges. No cyan on this specific band.
Lighting: controlled luxury product photography; broad soft upper-left key; subtle cool reflections on brushed steel; realistic contact occlusion inside the weave. Mature editorial craft, impressive material presence. No excessive shine, plastic, neon, hologram or sci-fi.
Composition: front-center clasp face nearly level, no Dutch angle; entire object centered, complete silhouette, 12 percent transparent margin all around. Intended to display at 360px wide. Square canvas. No ground plane, environment, human hand, wrist, other objects, text, numbers, logos, letters, badges, UI or symbols. All words and symbols will be native editable interface elements outside the art.
Maintain believable strap continuity all the way around the oval. This is a static product-art reference, not a model or rig.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the edit target and exact geometry reference. Make the dating material variant of this Proximeet wristband. Change ONLY the coral textile to rich orchid purple and its surface weave to fine diagonal herringbone weave. Preserve the identical oval silhouette, closed front-center brushed stainless clasp, graphite gasket, camera angle, scale, position, framing, band width, lighting direction and transparent margins. Keep restrained ivory edge stitching. Exquisite believable woven fibers, premium product photography. Preserve all transparent alpha, including the inner oval opening. Keep the entire object visible. No text, logos, letters, symbols, UI, scene, hand or wrist. Do not change the pose or hardware. The result must match the reference so the four bands form one coherent family.
